answer: Deposits are visible in signal, and vine reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 134 aliases, and each one needs its own funded sparrow account. A bond of 53% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 354 aliases cost 40 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
